meta.subtitle: Local static analysis · source groups and candidate imports, not runtime topology

cards.title: Detected locally
items: No source code executed. No model or network required.

cards.title: Interpretation limits
items: Groups reflect source files/directories, not verified services.
JS/TS imports use syntax parsing; Python, embedded scripts and unsupported syntax use lexical candidates.
Imports do not prove execution. Computed imports and external package resolution may be unresolved.
